purpose: Define machine-readable provenance and evidence requirements for canonical facts, projections, traces, completeness claims, semantic gaps and lock eligibility.

value.name: Propagate provenance through derived read models
Trace derived fact to authoritative source
Preserve provenance from canonical source to derived use

value.evidence_rule: A machine-significant validation claim must retain explicit evidence sufficient for a generic validator to reproduce or reject the claim.
value.source_rule: Provenance identifies where a fact came from; it does not change whether that source is authoritative. Source-role semantics determine authority separately.
value.projection_rule: Derived projections preserve source provenance and their transformation provenance. Projection output is never its own semantic source merely because it is easier to consume.
value.topic_rule: Inherited/composed Topic facts preserve both original semantic provenance and Topic-derived grouping provenance.
value.trace_rule: Every trace hop carries the explicit ref/edge used plus the provenance of the underlying semantic fact.
value.gap_rule: Semantic gap evidence identifies the failed deterministic reconstruction point and affected refs.
value.lock_rule: Lock eligibility evidence must identify the validation results supporting every applicable required validation dimension.
value.human_prose_rule: Human-readable explanation may accompany evidence, but prose alone is not machine-valid evidence for a semantic claim.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

value.purpose: Group canonical provenance and machine-readable evidence semantics.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant derived facts preserve a deterministic provenance chain to canonical source data.
Provenance records origin; it does not itself grant semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: A machine-significant derived fact cannot be traced to its explicit canonical source.
A derived fact has multiple conflicting source origins without explicit reconciliation.
Lock eligibility is asserted without machine-readable evidence for all applicable required validation dimensions.
Semantic completeness is asserted without evidence_refs supporting the claim.
A trace hop cannot identify the explicit canonical edge/reference that justifies it.
A derived projection is treated as the authoritative origin of semantics it merely projected.

references.purpose: Trace hops preserve edge and semantic provenance.
Lock eligibility requires evidence for every validation dimension.
Authority of provenance sources is determined independently by source-role semantics.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.

prose.summary: Makes every machine-significant derived canonical fact and validation claim traceable back to explicit source data with machine-readable evidence.
notes: Unlocked until the assembled 1.4 tree demonstrates provenance preservation across normalization, Topic projection, tracing and validation.
